verdict.rationale: Motion offers booking links and meeting templates, so round-robin team distribution is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence never mentions distributing inbound meetings across a team, round-robin assignment, or weighting and priority. Per-person daily meeting caps and project-level team capacity planning are adjacent features, not round-robin booking.

support.subject: As a sales lead, inbound meetings distribute across my team round-robin, with weighting or priority so load stays fair
